scenarios.trigger: A refactor moves validation from legacy_validate to validate_request.
scenarios.trap: The old function has no direct references, but its helper, fixture, export, and test remain.

scenarios.trigger: A handler is replaced, but a plugin registry loads its name from configuration.
scenarios.trap: A zero direct-reference search would incorrectly delete a live runtime entry.

scenarios.trigger: A public API is replaced while an older mobile client remains supported.
scenarios.trap: Deleting the shim breaks a real consumer even though internal callers migrated.

scenarios.trigger: A feature flag rollout is completed and the new path is canonical.
scenarios.trap: Only deleting the branch leaves the flag key, environment setting, dashboard label, and runbook stale.

scenarios.trigger: A public symbol is renamed and its behavior changes slightly.
scenarios.trap: Source compiles while README examples, comments, version notes, and API descriptions still teach the old contract.

scenarios.trigger: A new task needs behavior already owned by an existing adapter.
scenarios.trap: Adding a third helper appears faster but creates competing business rules.

scenarios.trigger: A new module implements the same normalization contract under different names.
scenarios.trap: Name-based search misses the duplicate, while two implementations can diverge on edge cases.

scenarios.trigger: A replacement removes an old endpoint and changes the supported request shape.
scenarios.trap: The source and tests are current, but a changelog entry and package version description still teach the retired contract.
